subject: ICT
title: Rain of Words
subtitle: Type the words before they fall
hero_picture: A girl sitting cross-legged on the floor playing a game of tossing and catching small pebbles, a cat and a cartoon laptop watching.

sections.heading: Catch the stones
text: She throws them up and catches them.
Catch them before they fall down!
sections.caption: Playing with stones
sections.picture: A girl tossing small pebbles up and catching them with one hand, pebbles in the air.

sections.heading: The keyboard
text: Each key has a letter or a number.
Press a key and the letter appears on the screen.
sections.caption: Fingers on the keyboard
sections.picture: A child's hands on a laptop keyboard, fingers pressing the keys, close-up.

sections.heading: Falling words
text: Words fall down like rain: bat, cup.
Type each word before it reaches the ground.
sections.caption: Words falling like rain
sections.picture: A laptop screen with a desert sky scene and two short lowercase words in big blue letters floating down: bat and cup.

sections.heading: Read and type
text: Find c, then u, then p on the keyboard.
Press them one by one. The word disappears!
sections.caption: Typing a word
sections.picture: A boy reading the word cup on a laptop screen and typing it, with a picture of a cup beside the laptop.

sections.heading: Words and things
text: A bat to play. A cup to drink.
A hat for the head. A pen to write.
sections.caption: Words and objects
sections.picture: Picture cards on a table: a bat, a cup, a hat and a pen, each with a matching object beside it (no letters).

rhyme: Bat and cup fall to the ground,
Words are caught by you and me!
activity: Write the words bat, cup, hat and pen. Draw a picture next to each.
talk: How do we type a word?
Name a thing that starts with 'c'.
summary: We read the falling word and type its letters on the keyboard to catch it.

questions.prompt: What do we use to type letters?
questions.explanation: We press keys on the keyboard.

questions.prompt: In 'Falling Words', what do we do?
questions.explanation: We type each word before it falls.

questions.prompt: What did Ammu throw and catch?
